subjective.text: Daniel has had a tight chest for about three hours.
Daniel is experiencing shortness of breath and wheezing.
Daniel reports having asthma and hayfever.
Daniel has had a cold with runny nose and sore throat recently.
Daniel is currently not using his inhalers (Clenil Modulite and Ventolin).
Daniel's mother has eczema and his father has asthma.
Daniel had a tube put down his throat when he was in high school due to severe asthma exacerbation.

objective.text: No peak flow meter available with Daniel.
Daniel is not short of breath at rest but feels more short of breath when walking up stairs.
Daniel has a spacer for his inhalers.

assessment.text: Daniel is experiencing symptoms consistent with an asthma exacerbation and possibly a viral infection.
Daniel needs to be prescribed inhalers (Clenil Modulite and Ventolin).
Daniel should use the spacer for his inhalers as instructed.
Daniel may need time off work due to symptoms.

plan.text: Prescribe inhalers (Clenil Modulite and Ventolin) for Daniel.
Give Daniel a dose of steroids to dampen down his asthmatic response.
Recommend that Daniel rest until feeling better and seek further medical attention if symptoms worsen or are concerning.
